# AIL

> AIL (AI-First Language, pronounced "ale") is a native, garbage-collected, memory-safe systems language that humans and AI agents both program in. Source files are `.ail`; the CLI is `ail`.

Load the full card first (`ail card full`, or `llms-full.txt` below with the how-tos). It holds the whole language; bare `ail card` is only the 3,000-token core card, for a context too small for it. Run `ail explain RULE` for any diagnostic. `ail` is the installed command; in a checkout of this repository, run `./ail`.

## Read first

- [Full card and how-tos in one file](llms-full.txt): the language card and the how-tos, for a single load
- [Language card](docs/language-card.md): the whole language in one read (`ail card full`)
- [For agents](docs/for-agents.md): the loop, `ail check` output and exit codes, canonical patterns, common mistakes and their fixes
- [Quick reference](docs/quick-reference.md): the CLI, worked examples of the language and the common std modules on one page; [std-modules.md](docs/std-modules.md) has a row for each
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to work on AIL itself

## Look up

- [Tutorial](docs/tutorial.md): a first program to a working one
- [Packages](docs/packages.md): `ail.pkg`, dependencies, `ail.lock`, capability grants
- [Language specification](docs/spec/README.md): normative rules with IDs
- [Tools](docs/spec/22-tools.md): `ail new`, `task`, `context`, `ask`, `mcp`, `fix`, `edit`
- [Windows](docs/windows.md): install and day-to-day notes for PowerShell
